execution_rule: One task at a time. Revalidate current source and obtain explicit owner approval for task ID and exact write_allowlist before source mutation.

tasks.title: Resolve SHA-256 checkpoint-sensitive epoch authority and persistence contract
math_contract: Epoch is an identity digest, not an accuracy bound or numerical certificate.

Specify exact tuple and serialization: checkpoint index plus start/target IEEE-754 bit patterns; byte length/order, usize-to-u64 conversion/overflow, signed-zero and NaN/infinity policy, SHA-256 truncation and output endianness.
Specify persisted cache/session invalidation or migration from FNV/index-independent identity.
implementation_contract: Find owner-approved WP-02 authority or obtain explicit approval for an append-only decision record.
Do not infer authority from source comments or a passing golden test.
Rename F7 tests so names match SHA-256/index-sensitive behavior.
acceptance: Code, tests and owner-approved spec define one versioned serialization contract.
Golden cases cover checkpoint index, endpoints, serialization bytes, signed zero and non-finite inputs.
Persisted identity migration/invalidation is explicit and tested.
stop_conditions: If source authority is not found, do not change identity semantics; report exact missing authority.

tasks.title: Replace caller-forgeable contraction evidence with independently verified map-bound evidence
math_contract: For T_P(x)=x-PG(x), require invertible P and prove q_hi >= sup_{x in B2(xc,r)} ||I-P DG(x)||_2 with q_hi<1.
Prove rho_hi >= ||P G(xc)||_2 and rho_hi <= (1-q_hi)r. Every norm and arithmetic operation affecting these bounds must be outwardly enclosed.
A pointwise Jacobian sample or caller-supplied scalar q does not establish the derivative supremum over the complete closed ball.
implementation_contract: Bind canonical G/P identities, model digest/epoch, norm, center/radius, arithmetic backend and checker version.
Only opaque verifier-created evidence can mint Certified; deserialize/caller references cannot do so.
Callbacks without sound interval extensions remain EstimateOnly.
acceptance: Forged scalar metadata cannot produce Certified.
Wrong map, P, epoch, radius or norm is rejected.
Boundary tests with q near 1 and residual near (1-q)r pass outward checks.
Positive and negative tests cover the original contract.
stop_conditions: A metadata-only patch without a replayable derivative enclosure is not a fix.

tasks.title: Bind Leja normality witness to the exact operator at its consumer seam
math_contract: Normality and spectral bounds apply to the exact operator representation from which they were derived.
Approximate skew symmetry is not exact normality unless its defect is outwardly bounded and its spectral consequences are proved.
Gershgorin beta must enclose the same operator, scaling and dimension actually consumed.
implementation_contract: Bind witness to canonical operator digest, dimension, scaling/basis where relevant and model epoch.
Validate all identity fields at the actual Leja consumer, not only at construction.
Fail closed to EstimateOnly when identity or proof scope is missing.
acceptance: A same-dimension witness for another operator is rejected.
A stale epoch witness is rejected.
One-ulp and tolerance-near skew defects are rejected or accompanied by an outward perturbation proof.
Independent small-matrix controls pass.

tasks.title: Make Gershgorin spectral certification source-bound and outward-rounded
math_contract: For each row i, outwardly prove r_i >= sum_{j != i}|A_ij| and outwardly enclose A_ii-r_i and A_ii+r_i.
The matrix class must justify the claimed real spectral intervals; arbitrary nonsymmetric matrices can have complex eigenvalues.
The operator norm fallback must also be an outward bound.
implementation_contract: Only a private VerifiedSpectralEnclosure bound to the source matrix digest and epoch may mint Certified.
Caller-supplied intervals and Ritz values remain EstimateOnly unless independently verified.
NaN, infinities, overflow and failed outward arithmetic fail closed.
acceptance: Arbitrary intervals and a caller-selected source enum cannot mint Certified.
A one-ulp symmetry defect is rejected or rigorously bounded.
High-precision small-matrix controls lie inside computed outward enclosures.

tasks.title: Separate sampled nonnormal-growth diagnostics from rigorous full-slab enclosures
math_contract: Finite samples of mu_H(t_k) or alpha_max(t_k) do not bound their supremum over a continuous time slab.
A validated moving-metric bound requires slab enclosures for J,H,Hdot, a positive lower bound for H, an outward eigenvalue maximum, quadrature/remainder, metric jumps, QR defect and roundoff.
implementation_contract: Current sample-based observers advertise EstimateOnly/SampledDiagnostic.
A separate validated observer can advertise Certified only after the complete enclosure proof machinery exists.
acceptance: No sampled-only path reports Certified.
Negative controls cover missed peaks, fast H oscillation, singular H, metric jumps, QR loss and exp overflow.
Validated mode encloses independent analytic low-dimensional cases.

tasks.title: Resolve exported HybridRouteAutomaton versus live SwitchingSolver dispatch
math_contract: A route transition must preserve accepted physical state, time mark, tolerance/error-control invariants and all attempted-work accounting.
A standalone state-machine unit test is not evidence that the live solver uses that state machine.
implementation_contract: Either integrate HybridRouteAutomaton into the real dispatch path with explicit state mapping, or label it standalone/experimental and document DriveState as the live route controller.
acceptance: Actual SwitchingSolver runtime traces show the chosen dispatch implementation.
Positive/negative routing controls preserve state and work invariants.
README and public API use the actual runtime controller's name.

tasks.title: Harden partial-prefix and unsuccessful-Ok result semantics
math_contract: An accepted prefix is not a completed solution on [t0,T]. Endpoint success must use the API's declared endpoint semantics.
implementation_contract: Preserve API compatibility unless a separately authorized breaking release is selected.
Add a checked outcome helper/type or examples that require inspection of success, final_time, message and accounting_complete.
acceptance: Tests cover callback failure, max-step termination, no-progress, partial accepted prefix and full endpoint success.

tasks.title: Resolve per-problem disputed benchmark reference trajectories
math_contract: Reference uncertainty must be below the scored comparison threshold or the reference must itself be validated.
Agreement between two numerical solvers is empirical cross-check evidence, not a proof of exact solution enclosure.
implementation_contract: Investigate each problem's reference-dispute/refinement status.
Preserve original raw results and add append-only adjudication artifacts.
Use validated reference or independently justified refinement.
acceptance: Each problem has a source-hashed reference with complete states and justified uncertainty below the minimum comparison level.
No admitted matched row is reference-disputed.
All failed/refused attempts remain in raw evidence.

tasks.title: Pin clean source, binaries, runners and benchmark inputs
math_contract: Same-host identity is necessary but insufficient: comparisons need same mathematical problem, input, observable, output grid, achieved error and cost definition.
implementation_contract: Pin clean commit/tree, binary, runner, dependencies, Julia manifest, native solver versions, reference and corpus hashes.
Record CPU affinity, thread counts, host load, warmups, repetition count, medians and dispersion.
A dirty-build context cannot qualify official performance.
acceptance: All relevant hashes verify.
All compared arms use same runner/hardware protocol.
Failures, refusals, setup and speculative work remain accounted.

tasks.title: Admit matched-achieved-error work-precision comparisons
math_contract: At common target error E compare cost only for achieved error <=E using the same norm, reference, grid and state scaling.
Do not interpolate across solver failures or extrapolate beyond observed error bands without preregistration.
implementation_contract: Produce per-problem work-precision curves and explicit aggregation policy.
Include failures/refusals/timeouts and every work counter; null is not zero.
Report paired speed ratios and uncertainty.
acceptance: Every score row has valid source/reference and matched achieved error.
No diagnostic-only row is used for promotion.
Official thresholds are read from authoritative project source without modification.

tasks.title: Reconstruct and verify persistent eight-stage U-session continuation
math_contract: Write exact U-stage residuals, state variables, epoch dependencies and work accounting before implementation.
A resumed session preserves accepted state, controller state, tolerance/provider identity and accumulated work; visible-state restart is not equivalent when hidden controller state is omitted.
implementation_contract: Locate original eight-stage contract and current implementation.
Compare uninterrupted and staged continuation; invalidate reuse on model/provider/tolerance/window/mesh identity mismatch.
acceptance: All original eight stages complete on preregistered test set.
Resumed and uninterrupted observables/work state satisfy declared criteria.
Stale identity refusals preserve accounting.

tasks.title: Close U-stage residual, causal-depth and stiff-order accuracy evidence
math_contract: Derive each stage residual from implemented method coefficients and nonautonomous terms.
Prove causal-depth recurrence and include linear/nonlinear solve residuals.
Separate classical order, stiff order reduction and global error propagation.
implementation_contract: Map coefficients to stage equations and exact/symbolic rational checks.
Record residual/depth traces on the original corpus.
acceptance: Applicable order identities independently checked.
Original residual/causal-depth criteria pass.
Full-trajectory accuracy and failures reported.

tasks.title: Close fair A/B and total-work accounting
math_contract: Count accepted/rejected steps, callbacks, JVP/Jacobian, factorizations, Krylov, setup/teardown, pilots, refusals, speculative work and failed attempts.
A zero-allocation claim names the allocator instrumentation and exact temporal scope.
implementation_contract: Reconcile work counters against instrumented call probes.
Keep full-run allocation and hot-loop allocation separate; null is not zero.
acceptance: Accounting identity closes on all terminal paths.
Negative controls for failure, refusal, stale reuse and speculative discard pass.

tasks.title: Reproduce and resolve historical Givens/QR true-residual failure
math_contract: State exact orthogonality/residual invariant and norm.
Distinguish exact-arithmetic identity from finite-precision backward error.
implementation_contract: Recover original failing fixture and source identity; do not reconstruct from memory.
Reproduce current behavior and fix only demonstrated cause.
acceptance: Original failure reproduced or non-applicability justified with identity evidence.
Independent residual/orthogonality tests cover adversarial scaling and near-degeneracy.

tasks.title: Preserve negative controls, ignored tests and false-PASS resistance
math_contract: A negative control must fail for the intended mathematical/authority reason, not only because of an earlier panic or malformed input.
implementation_contract: Inventory ignored/filtered tests, false-certificate fixtures and refused routes.
Assert deterministic failure reasons and preserved state/work.
acceptance: Every critical finding has positive and negative controls.
Ignored/filtered tests are not counted as executed.
NOT_RUN/BLOCKED/FAIL/PASS remain separate.

tasks.title: Run full locked workspace verification on pinned compiler and clean worktree
math_contract: Build/lint is implementation evidence, not numerical correctness proof.
implementation_contract: Pin exact release compiler or explicitly define rolling-stable policy.
Run fmt, clippy -D warnings, workspace release tests/build/doc tests; preserve exact logs.
acceptance: Required commands pass on exact clean source/toolchain.
No test or tolerance is removed to force PASS.

tasks.title: Test re-entrant regime switching on adversarial stiff/nonautonomous systems
math_contract: Switching must preserve committed state, time, tolerance/error control and work accounting.
A heuristic stiffness indicator is not a rigorous stability theorem.
implementation_contract: Test at least two explicit-to-implicit and implicit-to-explicit re-entry cycles plus no-switch control.
Include nonautonomous forcing, order reduction and transient stiffness bursts.
acceptance: Transition/error/work traces are complete.
No chattering or state/work loss within preregistered bounds.
Performance claim uses BENCH-ACHIEVED evidence only.

tasks.title: Reconcile README and benchmark report claims to evidence authority
math_contract: Keep local error estimate, observed reference error, global bound, validated enclosure and release status as distinct claim types.
implementation_contract: Bind every performance number to dataset, runner, corpus and reference hashes.
Describe actual live dispatcher and API limitations.
acceptance: Every public claim maps to admissible evidence and declared scope.
No diagnostic-only artifact is phrased as release-qualified.

tasks.title: Final independent qualification by claim and supported-input scope
math_contract: No global validated-solver claim without full continuous solution enclosure and existence/uniqueness evidence on every accepted slab.
No class-wide performance claim without preregistered matched-achieved-error protocol and complete failure accounting.
implementation_contract: Issue scope-indexed verdict for API, numerical accuracy, validated enclosure, switching, reproducibility, performance and release.
Use one read-only fresh-context review only; no review-of-review.
acceptance: Relevant P0/P1 gates close or owner explicitly accepts narrower use scope.
All evidence hashes bind to exact qualified commit.
Owner approves exact claim scope and release decision.
stop_conditions: Open certificate-authority critical finding keeps validated-IVP qualification HOLD.
Any disputed benchmark reference keeps matched-performance promotion HOLD.
